description: 湧水量および地下水揚水量調査 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 板橋区. 【板橋区】湧水量および地下水揚水量調査に関するデータを掲載しています。. Coverage: 板橋区. The portal files it under the publisher 板橋区. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
